title: Ultra-realistic documentary lifestyle ph
prompt:
Ultra-realistic documentary lifestyle photography, mega-structure aesthetics with natural forced perspective, extreme low-angle ground-level camera looking upward, crystal-clear optical quality, full-frame professional photography, HDR, razor-sharp focus, natural daylight.

A real adult woman naturally leans toward the camera until her face fills most of the frame, bringing her eyes and smile extremely close to the lens while maintaining realistic proportions. She gently brushes a strand of hair behind one ear with one hand, wearing a warm, natural smile and making direct eye contact through the frame. Authentic skin texture, visible pores, realistic eyes, natural expression, candid everyday moment, not posing for a studio shoot.

Behind her, a real contemporary house remains visible from the same low-angle perspective, emphasizing height naturally. Blue sky with scattered white clouds. One large cloud naturally resembles the silhouette of a Lamborghini supercar, seamlessly blending with surrounding clouds as if formed by the wind, while the rest of the sky contains ordinary cloud formations. The cloud appearance is subtle and believable, preserving a natural meteorological look rather than an artificial object.

Ultra-photorealistic, real human, real architecture, real sky, physically accurate lighting, balanced exposure, premium optics, cinematic realism, extremely high facial detail, crisp eyelashes, realistic hair strands, natural depth of field, no beauty filter, no glowing subject, 9:16 vertical composition.

Cloud variation: Randomize the cloud formation on every generation while always keeping one naturally formed cloud resembling a Lamborghini, integrated into the surrounding white clouds with a realistic atmospheric appearance. Never duplicate the exact cloud shape between generations.

Negative Prompt: anime, manga, cartoon, illustration, watercolor, painting, sketch, CGI, 3D render, 2D art, plastic skin, beauty filter, glowing subject, studio lighting, exaggerated perspective, fisheye distortion, malformed anatomy, extra arms, extra hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, duplicated limbs, unrealistic smile, oversaturated colors, blur, low resolution, text, watermark, logo.
